description: Whether a named broker currently holds a licence on the Dubai Land Department register, their broker number, their company, and how many transactions the register attributes to them. A transaction count is a record of what the register attributes, not a measure of anyone: it is blank for the newly licensed and for anyone transacting under a colleague's number.

name.description: The broker's name as it appears on their licence.

name: dubai_broker_check
title: Check a Dubai broker on the register
